deviations.what: The code sets each patent's year from grant_year (fy = as.integer(grant_year)) instead of filing_year, so every base and forward window is built on grant years.

notes: Rules 2 to 11 and the defaults (5, 3, TRUE) match the spec, including the empty-base NA rule, the anti-join for new classes, the missing-class filter, and the one-row-per-firm-year output. The grant_year error also breaks the spec's check that adding a patent filed in year t leaves focal year t unchanged, and the 1987-2015 focal-year default is not coded, though focal years come in through firm_year.
